answer: A fixed-pool dilution bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 for a crystal share in a harbor pool capped at 40,000. A beacon calls one in ten shares each epoch; holders echo the crystal seal within an hour. Forged seals, reused shares, or missed echoes burn the lock; a rented-share ring fails. Each fake pays 45, so 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 and lock 70,000 for at most 40,000; the thousandth share is worth 40. Honest agents pay 45 once.
